decision_unit: one lane survey frame, scored on the lane it was taken for (the recorder's --lane-views frames: wrist RGB-D at the lane's survey station)

held_out_population.rule: held_out_generations.fresh of config/perception_splits.json (splits file sha256 72b40600...), sorted ascending, every second seed starting with the first (75 of 150 seeds); the burned version-1 held-out seeds are never used
held_out_population.why_a_subset: one simulator at a time at about one minute per seed; 75 seeds give about 450 lanes, enough for every sample size below
held_out_population.calibration_and_development_data: train and validation seeds only (78 seeds); the estimator's tolerances were chosen on them and are frozen in the commit that holds this file

arms.abstain: no identity channel (sidecar absent): count and geometry only; the primary arm for the count bound
arms.channel: the real /identify_product logic (CMB-112 round 2 registry, calibration and whitening, unchanged) on the framed rear-product crop, safe naming policy (name only what OCR or the barcode confirms)
arms.oracle: ablation, not a result: a perfect identity channel for whatever face is framed; shows the ceiling visibility alone puts on misplaced detection
arms.abstain+degrade: the same as abstain with the seeded depth blinding of stock/benchmark.py degrade_mask (half of the frames lose a band of 30-70 % of the image rows): the refusal protocol
arms.probes_reported_only: depth noise 0.5 %, 1 %, 2 % of range with 2 % pixel dropout (synthetic perturbation of the recorded frames, not a sensor model); channel with the embedding-alone naming policy (what the safe policy costs and prevents)

bounds.meaning: lanes whose measured coverage is at or above the producer's 0.90 floor: the share answered with a count within one product of the truth; a cannot-tell on such a lane is a miss
lanes whose measured coverage is below 0.90: the share the estimator refuses (cannot-tell)
of the low-coverage lanes the estimator did answer, the share more than one product off
answered lanes whose products are all the expected SKU: the share flagged misplaced

lanes whose misplaced product is the one nearest the camera (the only one a survey frame can show): the share flagged when the channel names it correctly. This bounds the estimator's logic, not the identity channel

pass_rule: a 'min' bound passes only if the LOWER limit of the 95 % Wilson interval is at or above the value, a 'max' bound only if the UPPER limit is at or below it, and only if required_n is met; otherwise fail (point estimate on the wrong side), or inconclusive (point estimate on the right side, interval or sample size not enough). Report whatever comes out; no re-tuning, one run per arm.
reported_without_bound: misplaced recall over all misplaced lanes, and over the rear-misplaced subset, for the abstain and channel arms (bounded above by what the camera can name; a lane the estimator did not flag is not a verified-clean lane)
conforming-but-misplaced lanes (a lane declared fully conforming that truly holds a misplaced product)
share of lanes with a named face, mean share of unverified products
empty-lane read-as-empty rate (the generator draws few empty lanes, so the sample is small)
everything above per lighting condition, per lane fill bucket, per product class and per arm

frozen_estimator_options.note: the values in stock/estimator.py and config/lane_stock.yaml at the commit that holds this file

training: none; AGENT_BRIEF section 3.3 holds. The identity channel is consumed as CMB-112 round 2 left it.
